name: CSV to Markdown
summary: Convert CSV to a GitHub-flavored Markdown pipe table — delimiter, headers, and column alignment.
description: Paste CSV and get a ready-to-paste Markdown table for README files, docs, and wikis. Options: delimiter (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe), header row toggle, trim fields, skip empty rows, pretty column padding, and global column alignment. Quoted fields and embedded commas are supported.

faqs.question: What Markdown format is used?
faqs.answer: GitHub-flavored Markdown pipe tables with a header row and alignment row (e.g. | :--- | ---: |).

faqs.question: Can I convert CSV without a header row?
faqs.answer: Yes — turn off “First row is header” and columns are named Column 1, Column 2, …

faqs.question: Are pipes in cell values escaped?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pipe characters inside cells are escaped as \| so the table stays valid.

faqs.question: Is my CSV uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
